instruction: Cinematic still of a medium full shot capturing three men dancing in a spacious indoor hall with a wooden floor. In the center foreground, the blonde man in the leather jacket (R1) poses with his head tilted back and left arm extended. To his left, the man in the white t-shirt and harness (R3) strikes a dance pose with arms bent overhead, looking forward. To the right, the man in the black mesh crop top (R2) stands slightly behind, arms raised in a stylized pose. The three perform a synchronized, non-contact dance routine in a staggered formation. The scene is illuminated by cool blue ambient light with purple highlights, casting soft shadows on the wooden floor.
